name: family-and-inheritance
description: Finnish family and inheritance law: marriage, the prenuptial agreement and the division of matrimonial property (avioliittolaki 234/1929), the position of a cohabiting partner (26/2011), custody, contact and maintenance of a child (361/1983 and 704/1975), succession, wills and distribution of an estate (perintökaari 40/1965), and guardianship and the continuing power of attorney (442/1999 and 648/2007).
